messages:
Priya: RCA posted for 2026-07-02 spike affecting embedding service. Link: <https://docs.redwood.com/rca/2890|RCA: embedding memory pressure>. TL;DR: sudden memory fragmentation during batch ramp caused short-lived OOMs and ~2% error spike for ~6m. No customer data exposed.

Priya: Owner actions below; please confirm ETAs and blockers.

Actions (owners):
- Add post-batch compaction step and guardrail to limit concurrent large batches (Ethan) — target 2026-07-08.
- Instrument shard-level memory fragmentation metric + alert (Mia) — target 2026-07-06.
- Replay with high-batch scenarios and validate compaction (eng-sre / Priya) — run by 2026-07-10.

Ethan: Taking compaction + guardrail. Will open PR and include canary plan.

Mia: Will add fragmentation metric and a 5m alert. Posting dashboard mock in #eng-infra later today.

inc-bot: Incident INC-36555 created and linked to RCA 2890. Assigned: Ethan, Mia, Priya.

Laura: Need a 1-line exec blurb for ops digest.

Priya: Exec blurb draft: "On 2026-07-02 the embedding service experienced brief memory fragmentation during high-batch traffic, causing short OOMs and a small error spike. Mitigations include compaction, batch guardrails, and added monitoring; verification in progress."

Laura: LGTM. I'll include it in the digest.

Priya: Please update INC-36555 with PR links and canary results. Weekly checkpoint invite sent for 2026-07-09 10:00 PT. Keeping this thread as single source of truth for follow-ups.
